tasks.title: Hover time
tasks.statement: A **{c} mAh** battery, hover current **{i} A**. How many minutes will the aircraft last if you use 80 % of the capacity?
tasks.solution: t = 0.8·Q/I: (0.8·c/1000)/i hours, ×60 for minutes. Below 20 % remaining, the cells drop off like an avalanche.

tasks.title: Current from the C rating
tasks.statement: A **{c} mAh** battery with a rated continuous discharge of **{k}C**. What continuous current is allowed (A)?
tasks.solution: I_max = C·Q. Marketing C ratings are inflated — the voltage sag under load is the real guide.
